description: Öffentlicher Straßenraum Hansestadt Lübeck is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This dataset describes the public road space in the road construction load of the Hanseatic city of Lübeck on the basis of the monthly ALKIS landfills. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Public street space Hanseatic City of Lübeck" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Widmung, Hansestadt Lübeck, öffentlicher Straßenraum, Einziehung, Schleswig-Holstein, öffentliche Verkehrsflächen. The listing shows 2023-02-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
